description: This file defines the LoginModel class for handling user login functionalities in the web application's identity area, including login processing, external login schemes retrieval, and basket transfer after login.

classes.name: LoginModel
classes.description: Handles user login page model, processing login requests, managing external authentication schemes, and transferring the basket upon successful login.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Initializes login page, clears external cookies, retrieves external login schemes, and sets the return URL.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Processes login form submission, authenticates the user, manages login states, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketToUserAsync
methods.description: Transfers an anonymous basket to the logged-in user if a basket cookie exists, then deletes the cookie.
